Our Platform Features

Everything You Need to Run a High Impact Internal Hackathon

Built for virtual, hybrid, and on ground programs, Buildora's AI powered platform manages every stage so your employees focus on building, not logistics.

BRANDED EVENT PAGE

Live in Hours, Not Weeks

Launch a fully branded internal hackathon page with no code and no delays

Manage registrations, problem statements, timelines, and announcements in one place

INTERNAL OUTREACH

Get Every Employee Excited to Participate

Targeted internal communications to drive awareness and registrations across teams

AI powered engagement tools ensure maximum participation from the right people

TEAM FORMATION

Break Silos. Build Better Teams.

Skill based smart matching brings together employees from different teams and functions

Built in collaboration tools keep teams aligned from ideation to final submission

PROGRAM MANAGEMENT

All of It. One Dashboard.

Manage every participant, communication, and workflow from one centralized place

Automated workflows handle shortlisting, mentor coordination, and evaluations end to end

MENTORSHIP & SUPPORT

Nobody Gets Stuck. Nobody Falls Behind.

30+ Buildora domain experts and mentors keep every team unblocked through the sprint

Structured support sessions ensure all teams stay on track and deliver their best work

IMPACT REPORTING

Show Leadership What Their Teams Built

Track participation, submission quality, and program outcomes in one dashboard

Generate executive ready reports that highlight the best ideas and recommended next steps

IP & SECURITY

Your Ideas Stay Yours. Always.

All submissions and solutions are fully private and visible only to your organisation

Enterprise grade security ensures your intellectual property never leaves your control
